# Calm

> Calm is the #1 meditation and sleep app, offering guided meditations, sleep stories, breathing exercises, and stress relief tools for mental wellness.

Calm provides a comprehensive digital wellness platform featuring meditation practices, sleep improvement content, and mindfulness tools. The site serves users across multiple regions with localized content and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Meditation App
- Sleep Stories
- Sleep Improvement
- Stress Relief
- Mental Health
- Mindfulness
- Breathe Bubble
- App Features
- User Testimonials
- Subscription Benefits

## Core Platform

- [Calm - The #1 App for Meditation and Sleep](https://www-cdn-dev.aws-dev.useast1.calm.com): Calm app homepage showcasing meditation, sleep stories, and stress relief features
